messages:
alex: noticed staging pool thrash when long-seq pins tiny KV pages; p95 up ~30% on some jobs.
priya: can you paste the minimal logs?
alex: snippet: [evictor] evict=128 tenant=17; [pin] pin=16 tenant=42 reason=inflight; [reconstruct] refault=16 latency=180ms
marco: sounds like pin() implies long-lived residency. two choices: TTL on leases or explicit reservation token. i prefer token.
ciara: sketch: try_reserve(tenant, pages, hint) -> optional token {id,duration_ms,priority_hint}; release_reservation(id)
priya: if reserve denied, callers can recompute or use ephemeral local staging for small ops (<= small_threshold). also add reservation_denied metric per tenant.
marco: token transfer during page handoff must be supported. implement handoff RPC that atomically moves token; if fails, fallback to revoke+retry.
ciara: evictor rules: honor HIGH tokens for duration_ms; treat transient tokens as demotable after duration_ms/2 to avoid indefinite protection.
priya: rollout plan: shim pin() -> try_reserve(duration=200ms) with deprecation warning; feature flag residency.try_reserve_enabled.
ciara: telemetry: reservation_accepted, reservation_denied, reservation_lifetime_histogram, transient_staging_count. alert if denied_rate > 1% for 5m per tenant.
marco: testing: unit races (reserve+evict), e2e microbench with 100 concurrent long-seq sessions measuring refault and p95.
alex: action items: priya draft RFC+telemetry by EOD Thu; alex add shim in kv cache by Fri; marco implement evictor honoring tokens next sprint; ciara add tests+dashboard.
residency-bot: note created: rfc-6954321012-ephemeral-reservation (draft).
alex: if RFC lands i'll schedule a canary. :thumbsup:
priya: marking RFC-followup in board. :white_check_mark:
